tonight.headline: Down 65.6 to 26.6 — Pickens 11.7, Rice 3.9 on the bench
body: Bad news first. George Pickens caught 5 of 9 for 67 (11.7) as Dallas blew a 21-point lead and lost 39-38 to Philadelphia, and Rashee Rice had 2 catches for 19 on your bench in Buffalo's 13-10 rain game (archive). With Golden's 4.9 and the Rams D/ST's 10, you have 26.6 banked against JuiceJam's 65.6. Tuten has still not practised (DNP Wednesday and Thursday) and Likely was limited both days. You are 3-8; ESPN gives you 31%.

Nothing to move this morning. Boswell kicks at 14:00 today with Mason Rudolph now Pittsburgh's quarterback. Friday's reports this afternoon set Tuten's and Likely's designations; the 10:30 Sunday plan is unchanged.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: JuiceJam still have Stroud (20.5), Collins (15.3), Pollard (14.3) and McConkey (12.3) on Sunday. If Tuten and Likely sit without the fallbacks made, 31 projected points become Taylor's 14.0 and a zero against a 39-point deficit.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Tony Pollard did not practise Thursday — listed as rest, not injury (Titans' official report) — so it is a watch, not a hole.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten practising Friday, and a big Daniels afternoon against Arizona, who allow the most QB points. Without both, 39 is a lot to make up.
